reading.title: The Loop Shuttle
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文把 Lesson 50 的“问 conductor 哪里下车”换到现代公园接驳车场景：Maya 参加一次 excursion，怕 lose her way，请 attendant 提醒她 where to get off，却因为 loop route 和沿途 view 坐过了一圈。重点练习 excursion、shuttle、route、front、view、realize、as far as 和 in that case。
passage: On Sunday, Maya joined a science-club excursion to a riverside park. A small loop shuttle served the greenhouse and hill path. Maya wanted the greenhouse, but she did not want to lose her way, so she asked the attendant, "Please tell me where to get off." Then she sat in the front to get a good view of the river. The driver followed the route slowly, and Maya watched birds over the water. After some time, the shuttle stopped beside the gate again. Looking round, Maya realized with a shock that she had passed the greenhouse and ridden the whole loop. The attendant said, "This is as far as this loop goes, but we are starting again now." Maya laughed. "In that case, I prefer to stay on and get off at the greenhouse next time."

questions.question: Where did Maya want to get off?
options: At the greenhouse.
At the boat pier.
At the school gate.
At the bus station in town.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 Maya wanted the greenhouse，所以她想在 greenhouse 下车。

questions.question: What help did Maya ask for?
options: She asked the driver to stop the whole excursion.
She asked the attendant to tell her where to get off.
She asked another student to lend her a phone.
She asked the attendant to change the route.
questions.explanation_zh: 她说 Please tell me where to get off，是请 attendant 提醒她在哪下车。

questions.question: Why did Maya sit in the front?
options: To sell tickets for the shuttle.
To get a good view of the river.
To help the driver read a map.
To hide from the other students.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文写道 she sat in the front to get a good view of the river，她坐前排是为了看风景。

questions.question: What did Maya realize when the shuttle stopped beside the gate again?
options: She had forgotten to join the science club.
The river had disappeared from the park.
She had passed the greenhouse and ridden the whole loop.
The attendant was trying to trick her.
questions.explanation_zh: Looking round 之后，她 realized with a shock that she had passed the greenhouse and ridden the whole loop。

questions.question: Why was Maya's final decision reasonable?
options: The shuttle was starting the loop again, so staying on would take her back to the greenhouse.
She no longer wanted to see the greenhouse.
The attendant told her to leave the park at once.
She preferred to lose her way for fun.
questions.explanation_zh: attendant 说这一圈到终点了，但接驳车马上又要重新开一圈，所以 Maya 继续坐一圈，就能在下一次到 greenhouse 时下车；这不是犯傻，而是顺势做决定。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓五个 Lesson 50 的“旅行、坐过站和重新决定”句式：用 I love..., but I don't like... 写喜欢与担心，用 took me longer than I expected 写时间超出预期，用 where to get off 请求下车提醒，用 Looking round, I realized... 写突然发现，最后用 In that case, I prefer to... 写听到新情况后的选择。

patterns.title: I love ..., but I don't like ...
patterns.source: I love travelling in the country, but I don't like losing my way.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个句式先说你喜欢的活动，再说你不喜欢的麻烦；Lesson 50 的故事就是从“喜欢旅行但怕迷路”开始的。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你喜欢一种活动，但不喜欢它带来的一个小麻烦。
patterns.sample: I love visiting new museums, but I don't like losing my way inside them.
patterns.tip_zh: love 和 don't like 后面都可以接动词 -ing，让前后结构更整齐。

patterns.title: took me longer than I expected
patterns.source: My trip took me longer than I expected.
patterns.focus_zh: take + 人 + 时间 能自然表达“某件事花了我多少时间”；longer than I expected 表示结果比预想更久。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一次作业、路程、排队或练习花的时间比你预想更长。
patterns.sample: The walk to the science hall took me longer than I expected.
patterns.tip_zh: 主语可以是 The trip, The homework, The bus ride；后面接 took me longer than I expected。

patterns.title: where to get off
patterns.source: I'll tell you where to get off.
patterns.focus_zh: where to + 动词 是很紧凑的表达，意思是“在哪里做某事”；在交通场景里，where to get off 特别实用。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你请司机、工作人员或朋友告诉你在哪里下车。
patterns.sample: Please tell me where to get off near the library.
patterns.tip_zh: 这个短语前面可以接 tell me, know, ask, remember；不要写成 where get off。

patterns.title: Looking round, I realized ...
patterns.source: Looking round, I realized with a shock that I was the only passenger left.
patterns.focus_zh: Looking round 放在句首，先给一个小动作，再写突然明白的事实；它能让发现的瞬间更有画面感。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你环顾四周后，突然发现自己坐过站、走错房间或只剩自己一个人。
patterns.sample: Looking round, I realized that I was the only student left on the shuttle.
patterns.tip_zh: 逗号后面要接完整句子：Looking round, I realized that...。

patterns.title: In that case, I prefer to ...
patterns.source: In that case, I prefer to stay on the bus.
patterns.focus_zh: In that case 表示“既然情况是这样”；prefer to 后面接动词原形，用来写你根据新信息做出的选择。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你听到车要返回、商店快开门或活动换地点后，决定更愿意怎么做。
patterns.sample: In that case, I prefer to stay on the shuttle until it reaches the gate.
patterns.tip_zh: 这句话适合放在故事结尾：先听到新情况，再给出更合理的选择。
